issues.title: Can't select same `Activity` twice
issues.body:
In the Story for `PlanningChannel` we have the `New Orders` button at the top-left.

If we click on `Maritime Transit` it invites us to draw a line.

But, if we click on `Maritime Transit` again, the event doesn't fire.

Clicking on a different button does work.

It _looks-like_ the issue is inside `L.control.select`. :-(
